name: NBFCs

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: NBFCs: Growth remains resilient; margin and asset-quality trends diverge
mofsl_2qfy27.read: NBFC coverage AUM grew ~18% YoY in 2QFY27, with vehicle financiers at 19%, large HFCs (PNBHF, LICHF, BAJAJHFL) at 12%, affordable and small-ticket HFCs ~14%, MFIs ~20% (up ~3% QoQ) and gold-loan NBFCs ~53% led by MUTH and MGFL; NII, PPoP and PAT grew 23%, 21% and 26% YoY. Asset quality was stable but a deficient monsoon is weighing on tractor, rural MSME and microfinance, and gold financiers saw a sharp rise in Stage 2 after revised repayment rules from Apr'26; margins diverged, with MUTH up 150bp QoQ and MGFL ~55bp while HFCs and vehicle financiers compressed on higher incremental cost of funds.

unit_economics: RoA = yield - cost of funds (NIM) + fees - opex - credit cost, with RoE = RoA x leverage (4.5-7x); growth is funded wholesale so spread, credit cost and capital headroom matter more than deposits.

price_drivers.why: Coverage AUM grew ~18% YoY and PAT ~27% YoY; gold lenders grew ~53% so segment growth gaps drive relative multiples (MUTH raised its FY27 guide to 25% from 15%).

Deficient monsoon is stressing tractor, rural MSME and MFI books while gold lenders show higher Stage 2 after the Apr'26 repayment rules; SHFL cut its AUM guide and expects 30-40bp seasonal credit cost.
Higher bond yields raised incremental CoF for HFCs and vehicle financiers; BAF expects NIM compression above its 10-15bp guide.
Gold-loan AUM growth of ~53% is price-led and MUTH NIM jumped 150bp QoQ; rule changes on monthly interest payment alter customer behaviour.
Insurance fees are 5-25% of PBT across lenders and draft IRDAI caps cut them; MOFSL notes distribution changes as a risk for financials broadly.

kpis.name: AUM growth and disbursement growth by segment
kpis.definition: Year-on-year growth in assets under management including assigned and co-lent loans, with disbursements by product.
kpis.formula: AUM (YoY); implied run-off = opening AUM + disbursements - closing AUM
kpis.why_it_moves_price: AUM growth drives NII and EPS compounding; MOFSL records ~18% overall and guidance moves (MUTH to 25%, SHFL cut to 15-17%, BAF 26-27%, TATACAP 23-25% medium term, PNBHF 18-20%).
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'AUM' and 'disbursement' by segment; get_financials for loans on balance sheet; Motilal Oswal results tables.
kpis.estimate_source: Management AUM guidance from transcripts (get_qa); broker models (Motilal Oswal, Kotak IE); get_consensus_estimates for PAT/EPS/BVPS (growth embedded).
kpis.traps: AUM vs on-book loans; off-book assignment and co-lending; gold price inflating gold AUM; mergers with restated history.

kpis.name: Credit cost (house basis incl. overlays, net of recoveries)
kpis.definition: Impairment on financial instruments including overlays and write-off losses, net of recoveries on written-off loans, over average on-book loans.
kpis.formula: (impairment charge incl. overlays - recoveries) / average on-book loans, annualised
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Credit cost is the main variable in NBFC RoA; SHFL flagged 30-40bp extra for affected geographies, and falling cost driven by cover cuts or overlay use rather than slippage is lower quality.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'credit cost' and 'provisions'; get_financials (impairment on financial instruments); Motilal Oswal results tables.
kpis.estimate_source: Management credit cost guidance from transcripts (SHFL below 2.3%); broker models; no consensus field for credit cost.
kpis.traps: Recoveries moved from income to impairment (BAF restated); overlay builds and releases; cover cuts flatter cost; guarantee fees in opex; credit cost quoted on assets vs loans.

kpis.name: NIM and cost of funds
kpis.definition: Net interest income over average assets or loans, with yield and cost of funds on each company's stated basis.
kpis.formula: (Interest income on loans - finance cost) / average assets; CoF = finance cost / average borrowings
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Margins diverged in Q2FY27: HFCs and vehicle lenders compressed on higher incremental CoF, MUTH rose 150bp QoQ and MGFL ~55bp; BAF now sees NIM compression above its 10-15bp guide.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'NIM', 'yield', 'cost of funds'; get_financials for interest income and finance cost; Motilal Oswal results tables.
kpis.estimate_source: Management NIM guidance from transcripts (BAF compression note); broker models; no consensus field for NIM.
kpis.traps: NIM is defined five ways (BAF does not report; PFL and ABCL include fees; deck CoF vs interest/loans); daily vs simple averages; floating-rate gap sets sensitivity to hikes.

kpis.name: Stage 2 and Stage 3 loans (net formation)
kpis.definition: Gross and net Stage 2 plus Stage 3 loans by segment and their quarterly formation, with write-offs and ARC sales added back.
kpis.formula: Net S2+S3 formation = change in S2+S3 + write-offs - recoveries and upgrades
kpis.why_it_moves_price: S2 leads GNPA and credit cost by 1-2 quarters; MOFSL flags a sharp rise in Stage 2 at gold financiers and drought-related stress in tractor, rural MSME and MFI portfolios.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'Stage 2', 'GNPA', 'collection efficiency'; get_financials for provisions by stage where disclosed.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; management comments on stress and cures from transcripts; broker asset-quality tables (Motilal Oswal).
kpis.traps: Different staging rules (borrower-level contagion vs account-level); ARC sales and technical write-offs shrink GNPA; seasonal Q2 GNPA rise; restructured loans.

kpis.name: ECL coverage and overlays
kpis.definition: Stage 1, Stage 2 and total ECL cover, plus management overlays held and built in the quarter.
kpis.formula: ECL / loans by stage; overlay stock and flow
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Cover cuts boost reported credit cost; thin cover leaves less buffer if drought stress extends from MFI to vehicle and rural books.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'ECL', 'overlay', 'provision coverage'; get_financials.
kpis.estimate_source: Management commentary from transcripts; broker models.
kpis.traps: Overlay flows and stocks do not reconcile across deck, call and annual report; model refreshes.

kpis.name: Gold-loan AUM growth, LTV and Stage 2
kpis.definition: Gold-loan AUM growth, loan-to-value and Stage 2 share after the Apr'26 repayment-rule changes.
kpis.formula: Gold AUM YoY; LTV = loan / gold value; S2 / gold loans
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Gold NBFCs grew ~53% YoY with MUTH NIM +150bp QoQ; Stage 2 jumped on monthly interest-payment rules, so growth and margin are strong but behavioural risk is rising.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'gold loan AUM', 'LTV'; get_financials for loan book.
kpis.estimate_source: Management guidance from transcripts (MUTH 25% FY27 growth); broker models; no consensus for LTV.
kpis.traps: Gold price inflates AUM; auctions and Stage 2 timing; new loan variants with monthly interest.

kpis.name: Insurance and fee income as share of PBT
kpis.definition: Insurance distribution commission from the annual report fee note as a share of PBT, with core fees to assets.
kpis.formula: Insurance commission / PBT; core fees / average assets
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Draft caps could cut a 5-25% PBT share (highest at LTF and HDB on broker estimates); IIFL puts LTF PBT at the largest risk.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (fees and commission); annual report fee note via list_library_documents; get_investor_presentation for fee splits.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker regulatory-impact notes in the report library; management mitigation from transcripts.
kpis.traps: Subsidiary insurance broker income stressed once; assignment gains inside fees.

kpis.name: Tier-1/CRAR, leverage and funding mix
kpis.definition: Capital ratios, assets-to-equity leverage and share of floating or short-term borrowings with refinancing wall.
kpis.formula: Tier-1/CRAR; assets / equity; floating share of loans minus floating share of borrowings
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Raising equity at 5x leverage dilutes RoE; incremental CoF rose for several NBFCs in Q2FY27 and the floating gap sets sensitivity to the rate cycle.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'CRAR', 'Tier 1', 'leverage', 'borrowing mix'; get_financials.
kpis.estimate_source: Management capital-raise plans from transcripts; broker models; get_consensus_estimates for BVPS.
kpis.traps: Leverage defined differently; standalone vs consolidated Tier-1; warrants and QIP not yet in shares.

valuation_anchor: P/B (and P/ABV) against RoE, with justified P/B = (RoE - g)/(CoE - g); diversified lenders on residual income, gold lenders on P/B and P/E against AUM growth, subsidiaries valued as a SOTP line only when the lending parent is valued standalone.
watch_next_quarter: Watch NIM recovery or compression as incremental CoF rises in 3Q-4QFY27 (BAF flags compression above its guide), Stage 2 and credit cost in drought-affected tractor, rural MSME and MFI books (SHFL expects 30-40bp extra for one or two quarters), gold-loan Stage 2 normalisation after the Apr'26 rules, and delivery against raised AUM guidance (MUTH 25%, BAF 26-27%, CIFC 22-23%).
